mentions.name: Heirloomreel
mentions.description: This webapp manages digitized home VHS tapes by splitting the videos into clips, transcoding them for better streaming, adding Google Cast support, and providing tagging for search so the right video is easy to find and play.
mentions.problem: Playing digitized home VHS videos from Google Drive was troublesome and finding the right video was difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also recently got a lot of home VHS tapes digitalized and always had trouble with playing from Google drive or finding the right video. So I just built a webapp this month to split the videos into clips, transcoding it for better streaming, Google casting support, and tagging for search. [1]
